items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: I had one violin and fifteen musicians... I said you can go, Bluett, you can go.

ctx.x: Well, when did you notice when they moved away from using the violins so much in dance orchestras and they just got more towards brass and reeds? What do you think counted for that?

Well I think the thing, the violins didn't fit with two beat music. They could play it, but I mean it didn't fit in that combination and he'd sit there most of the time if he didn't pluck it he'd have it as a rap. You know what I mean? I used the violin to play the shows and I'd let him go. I played carnival balls. I had one violin and fifteen musicians. And when we got through playing false blues I said you can go, Bluett, you can go. And we don't need you because we're going to be hammering our carnival ball,…
